items.title: VLANs, 802.1Q Trunks and Rapid PVST+
items.description: Build VLANs, static 802.1Q trunks with a native VLAN, and control the Rapid PVST+ root bridge.

items.title: EtherChannel with LACP and PAgP
items.description: Bundle parallel links into an LACP trunk port-channel and a PAgP access port-channel.

items.title: OSPFv2 Multi-Area, Stub Area and Summarization
items.description: Build a three-area OSPFv2 design with point-to-point links, a stub area and inter-area summarization.

items.title: EIGRP Named Mode, Authentication and Stub
items.description: Configure EIGRP named mode with MD5 authentication, a stub router and passive loopbacks.

items.title: BGP - eBGP and iBGP with next-hop-self
items.description: Peer three autonomous systems, run iBGP between loopbacks over OSPF, fix the next-hop problem and advertise prefixes.

items.title: HSRPv2 First-Hop Redundancy with Object Tracking
items.description: Provide a redundant default gateway with HSRP version 2, priority, preemption and interface tracking.

items.title: ACLs, PAT and Static NAT
items.description: Translate a private LAN with PAT, publish an internal host with static NAT and filter Telnet with a named extended ACL.

items.title: VRF-Lite with Overlapping Customer Addressing
items.description: Separate two customers with identical addressing on one router using VRF-lite and per-VRF static routing.

items.title: GRE over IPsec with OSPF
items.description: Build a GRE tunnel between two sites across an ISP, run OSPF over it, and protect it with an IPsec profile.

items.title: NTP, Syslog, SNMPv3 and IP SLA
items.description: Build an authenticated NTP hierarchy, remote syslog with timestamps, an SNMPv3 authPriv user and an ICMP IP SLA probe.

items.title: IP SLA Reachability Tracking with HSRP Failover
items.description: Detect an upstream outage that keeps the link up with an IP SLA probe, then withdraw the static default route and fail HSRP over to the backup router.

items.title: Policy-Based Routing for a Second ISP
items.description: Send Engineering's traffic out a second ISP with a route-map and ip policy, while everyone else follows the default route.

items.title: Mutual OSPF/EIGRP Redistribution with Route Tags
items.description: Redistribute between OSPF and EIGRP at two border routers, using route-maps that tag routes and filter them on the tag to prevent feedback loops.

items.title: Multicast: PIM Sparse Mode with a Static RP
items.description: Enable IP multicast routing and PIM sparse mode on three routers, point them at a static RP, join a receiver with IGMP and verify the shared tree, the source tree and the RPF check.

items.title: Multicast: BSR RP Election, IGMPv3 and SSM
items.description: Replace static RPs with a Bootstrap Router (BSR) election between two candidates, run IGMPv3 at the receiver edge and add a source-specific multicast (SSM) channel that needs no RP at all.

items.title: MPLS: LDP Label Distribution in the Core
items.description: Turn an OSPF core into an MPLS core with LDP, pin the LDP router ID to a reachable loopback, and read label bindings, the forwarding table, penultimate-hop popping and an LSP ping.

items.title: MPLS L3VPN: VRFs and MP-BGP VPNv4 (advanced)
items.description: Build a basic MPLS Layer 3 VPN over an existing LDP core - customer VRF with RD and route targets on both PEs, an iBGP VPNv4 session between the PE loopbacks, and eBGP to the customer sites inside the VRF.

items.title: Walkthrough: BGP EVPN VXLAN spine-and-leaf (NX-OS 9000v)
items.description: Step-by-step build of a VXLAN EVPN fabric - OSPF underlay, iBGP EVPN with the spines as route reflectors, NVE/VTEPs with ingress replication, and VLANs 10 and 20 stretched across both leaves (optional L3VNI with an anycast gateway).

items.title: Data center: VXLAN EVPN fabrics
items.description: Data center fabric basics on Nexus 9000v: a guided walkthrough that builds a spine-and-leaf VXLAN fabric with a BGP EVPN control plane and stretches VLANs between leaves (optional L3VNI and anycast gateway). RAM heavy: about 52 GB of CML RAM (4 x nxosv9000 at 12 GB). Its labs come from the lab library (installed with the course; built in before ENCOR Lab Builder 2.0.0).

items.title: EIGRP Basic Adjacency (AS 100)
items.description: Two routers, one link. Bring up EIGRP AS 100 so each router learns the other's loopback.

items.title: Multicast and MPLS track
items.description: IP multicast, then MPLS: PIM sparse mode with a static RP, BSR with IGMPv3 and SSM, VRF-lite as a warm-up for VRFs, LDP in a provider core, and finally an MPLS L3VPN with MP-BGP VPNv4. Its labs come from the lab library (installed with the course; built in before ENCOR Lab Builder 2.0.0).

items.title: ENCOR Infrastructure: routing track
items.description: The core routing labs in a sensible order: EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, VRF-lite, PBR and OSPF/EIGRP redistribution. No labs are bundled, so this course is tiny and only records the study order and your progress through it.

items.title: OSPF Mastery: design, areas and troubleshooting
items.description: Three labs in study order: multi-area OSPF basics, ABR summarization with a totally stubby area, then a 7-node troubleshooting ticket. Bundles the two community labs; the first one is built in.

items.title: OSPFv2 Multi-Area: ABR Summarization and a Totally Stubby Area
items.description: Four routers, two OSPF areas. Make area 1 totally stubby and summarize its loopbacks to a /22 on the ABR.

items.title: Troubleshooting: Branch-2 Cannot Reach the Data-Center Server
items.description: Seven-router multi-area OSPF enterprise, fully configured. Users at Branch-2 can't reach the DC server. Find and fix the one fault.
